Visualise of cna signal and correlation

cna_scores_plot.Rd

Visualise Malignant and Non-Malignant Subsets of cells. This is achieved by plotting, for each cell, its CNA signal over its CNA correlation. Please see cna_compute_scores.

Usage

cna_scores_plot(
  cna_scores,
  signal_threshold = 0.05,
  correlation_threshold = 0.5
)

Arguments

cna_scores

cna scores info get from cna_compute_scores or cna_classify_cells

signal_threshold

The threshold of cna scores

correlation_threshold

The threshold of cna correlation

Value

return a ggplot object

See also

cna_compute_scores cna_classify_cells
